claims.head: Like for like: Suter against Dach
claims.call: The Blues’ L4 (Kaskimäki, Suter and Stenberg) spends at least 46% of its 5-on-5 time against the Canadiens’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Blues keep sending Suter’s line (Kaskimäki, Suter and Stenberg) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jim Montgomery keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Canadiens’ fourth line is Dach, Evans and Xhekaj.

claims.gist: At home, Jim Montgomery likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canadiens’ fourth line.

claims.head: The Canadiens’ goalie is in for some dangerous shots
claims.call: The Blues’ average shot has at least their usual 6.9% chance of going in.
claims.body: The Blues’ shots are some of the most dangerous in the league, and the Canadiens are one of the worst at preventing dangerous ones. Look for plenty of good chances.

notes.text: Nick Suzuki is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Oliver Kapanen has taken his spot beside Cole Caufield and Juraj Slafkovský.

Ivan Demidov is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 9 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Kirby Dach has taken his spot beside Alex Newhook and Juraj Slafkovský.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
David Reinbacher was added to the roster on Oct 15.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
Oliver Kapanen is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, down from 33% last season.
Arber Xhekaj has started killing penalties: on the ice for 27% of the team’s shorthanded time in 11 games, up from 6% last season.
Logan Mailloux is out long term and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Colton Parayko has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg.
Aleksanteri Kaskimäki was added to the roster on Oct 18 and has played beside Pius Suter and Otto Stenberg.
Otto Stenberg was added to the roster on Oct 19 and has played beside Pius Suter and Aleksanteri Kaskimäki.

STL.head: The Blues start a half-step ahead
STL.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. St. Louis has home-ice advantage, while Montréal will be without Suzuki. Still, it’s close: the Canadiens can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

MTL.head: The Canadiens start a half-step behind
MTL.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. St. Louis has home-ice advantage, while Montréal will be without Suzuki. The Canadiens’ best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.

story.head: The Canadiens’ goalie is in for some dangerous shots
paras: The Blues are 5-5-1. The Canadiens have won two in a row.

items.text: The Canadiens are newly without Nick Suzuki, and have been without Samuel Montembeault and Ivan Demidov for several games. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
The Blues have been without Logan Mailloux all season.
Josh Anderson is set to play his 700th NHL game.
Robert Thomas has a point in five straight games against Montréal, and 12 points in his last five against them.
